mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_sources s LEFT JOIN checkins c ON s.source_type='checkin' AND c.id=s.source_id AND c.user_id=s.user_id LEFT JOIN conversation_messages cm ON s.source_type='conversation_message' AND cm.id=s.source_id AND cm.user_id=s.user_id AND cm.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN conversations cv ON cv.id=cm.conversation_id AND cv.user_id=s.user_id AND cv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.memory_id=m.id AND s.user_id=m.user_id AND s.active=1 AND ((s.source_type='checkin' AND c.id IS NOT NULL) OR (s.source_type='conversation_message' AND cv.id IS NOT NULL)))
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, category, memory_text, strength, archived, embedding_json, updated_at FROM memories WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.category, m.memory_text, m.strength, m.archived, m.embedding_json, m.updated_at FROM memories m WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_sources s WHERE s.memory_id=m.id) OR ) LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.category, m.memory_text, m.strength, m.archived, m.embedding_json, m.updated_at FROM memories m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.archived = 0 AND ORDER BY m.strength DESC, m.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.category, m.memory_text, m.strength, m.archived, m.embedding_json, m.updated_at FROM memories m WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.archived = 0 AND LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE memories SET category = #{category}, memory_text = #{memoryText}, strength = #{strength}, archived = #{archived}, embedding_json = #{embeddingJson}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM memories WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memories WHERE embedding_json IS NOT NULL AND embedding_json <> ''
SELECT id, user_id, category, memory_text, strength, archived, embedding_json, updated_at FROM memories ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
